revision_history.reason_superseded: red-team found ambiguous activation, a weak or non-unique projected-ridge definition, an unfrozen train/selection frame boundary, and non-executable ablation decisions

revision_history.changes: separates current and required activation state; strengthens projected ridge with fit-only nested selection and unique math; freezes frame, seed, update, and precision contracts; defines same-seed ablation decisions; narrows mechanism claims; discloses all missing runtime implementations

role: Result-blind executable specification for the four parent-required controls deferred until a fully independently validated Stage A pass. It does not activate, fit, predict, score, or authorize any control by itself.

activation_gate.runtime_evidence_binding: a later immutable execution release must bind the formal Stage A result, independent VALIDATED_READY, scoring report, source closure, and all parent digests before any control fit or prediction process can start
activation_gate.action_if_not_activated: do not implement, fit, predict, or score these controls; retain the Stage A failure or cheap-control-dominance result

shared_roster.outer_split: leave one complete PoolFire trajectory out

controls.fit_target: for each known geometry separately, use observation-RMS-normalized, supported, zero-mean reference-chart truth rows from the four outer-fit trajectories, seven fit maps, and ten train frames 0 through 90; frame 100, outer-heldout truth, and heldout composed maps are absent from mean, SVD, and guard

fit_only_model_selection.split: fit mean, basis, and guard on frames 0 through 90; select rank, lambda, and beta only on frame 100 of the same four outer-fit trajectories
fit_only_model_selection.geometry_partition: run an independent complete search, basis, guard, and selection for each frozen known geometry; no geometry is pooled and each outer fold produces exactly three selected hyperparameter triples
fit_only_model_selection.objective: within each geometry separately, apply the exact formal v111 fit-only checkpoint score to four trajectories by seven fit maps at frame 100, then tie-break by lower rank, larger ridge lambda, and smaller beta
fit_only_model_selection.post_selection_refit: none; retain the geometry-specific mean, basis, and guard built from all four outer-fit trajectories, seven fit maps, and frames 0 through 90

basis_construction.mean: float64 arithmetic mean of the complete inner-fit or outer-fit target matrix
basis_construction.mode_order: descending singular value order returned by SVD
basis_construction.sign_canonicalization: for each right singular vector, find the first smallest-index entry attaining the maximum absolute value and multiply the mode by the sign required to make that entry nonnegative
basis_construction.coefficient_target: centered_target_matrix multiplied by the transposed sign-canonicalized right-singular-vector rows
basis_construction.degenerate_rank_action: reject if the selected singular value is non-finite or not strictly positive

projected_ridge_math.physical_projection: Q_physical(x) = support * (x - sum(support*x)/sum(support)); Q_physical is linear, uses the frozen operator support, and is applied identically to every pushed mean, mode, proposal, and q8 anchor
projected_ridge_math.reference_to_physical_order: T_map = Q_physical composed with the single frozen analytic reference-to-physical push; compute A_g T_map(mean) and A_g T_map(mode_j) for the same fields later used by the initializer
projected_ridge_math.observation_normalization: divide the deployment observation and loaded-q8 anchor by the same current-frame observation RMS used by DRC-Warm
projected_ridge_math.projected_modes: P columns are A_g(T_map(mode_j)) in canonical mode order
projected_ridge_math.solve: numpy.linalg.solve(G + lambda * trace(G)/rank * I, b); reject a non-finite or non-positive-definite system
projected_ridge_math.generic_rank_implementation_status: not implemented; a new tested generic-rank core must reproduce these formulas and bind its source before activation

coefficient_guard.scale: fit-target coefficient population standard deviation when greater than 64*float64_epsilon*max(1,max_abs_dimension), otherwise one
coefficient_guard.radius: maximum fit-row Euclidean norm after centering and scaling
coefficient_guard.projection: radially project every proposal onto the closed standardized ball; reject non-finite center, scale, radius, or proposal

controls.geometry_action: for each outer fold, heldout map, and known geometry, push the final fit-only reference mean and selected modes once and precompute their exact forward actions

fit_only_search_exact_call_accounting.maximum_rank_projection_cache: within each outer fold, geometry, and fit map, compute A_g T_map(mean) plus all 32 ordered modes once; every lower-rank candidate reuses the corresponding prefix
fit_only_search_exact_call_accounting.candidate_replay_formula: 3 geometries * 4 fit trajectories * 7 fit maps * one frame-100 row * 64 candidates
fit_only_search_exact_call_accounting.selection_reference_strategy: for each frame-100 cell, run one Zero-CGLS K4 recurrence and retain both K2 and K4 checkpoints; separate K2 and K4 runs are forbidden
fit_only_search_exact_call_accounting.heldout_map_setup_A_per_outer_fold: sum over three geometries of 6 * (1 + selected_reference_rank_for_geometry)

online_shell.anchor: h_q8_physical = Q_physical(A_g^T z_q8 / observation_rms) with exactly one exact A^T
online_shell.physical_initializer: x0_physical = observation_rms * x0_normalized_physical; no additional support or gauge operator may be inserted after coefficient selection
online_shell.observable_line_search: reuse A_g x0; reject only a non-finite denominator, set alpha=0 when denominator<=1e-30, otherwise alpha=max(<y,A_g x0>,0)/denominator; replace x0 by alpha*x0 before forming the K1 residual, exactly matching the parent fallback
online_shell.refinement: reuse the line-search forward action to form y-A_g(alpha*x0), apply exact A_g^T once, apply exact A_g once to the CGLS direction, and take unchanged CGLS K1

controls.hyperparameter_selection: complete deterministic fit-only frame-100 Cartesian search over 4 ranks by 4 lambdas by 4 betas independently for each geometry; partial candidate rosters are invalid
forbidden: outer-heldout truth in mean, basis, guard, ridge, or beta
heldout composed maps in fit target construction
rank, lambda, or beta selection from Stage A or outer-control results
hiding basis construction, inner search, or selected-rank setup forward actions from whole-pipeline reporting

controls.parent_label: v29-style temporal 3-D CNN without pose or map channels
controls.kind: small causal physical-chart v29-backbone ablation on the v111 cheap-factor inputs

features: current minus previous physical cheap factor backprojection

controls.relationship_to_v29: reuses the 10524-parameter DirectFieldTemporalCNN backbone and five-channel causal layout but replaces v29 exact geometry-equalized BP with v111 cheap-factor BP to preserve the common 2A+2AT deployment budget; it is not a reproduction of v29
controls.information_boundary: no explicit pose, geometry, map, or Jacobian channels are accepted; observation-derived q8/base/BP fields and support can still carry implicit geometry information, so this is not a geometry-independent control
controls.causal_previous_rule: frame 0 repeats current; every later selected frame reads the immediately preceding physical frame from the same trajectory
controls.normalization: current-frame observation RMS, independently per trajectory, geometry, map, and frame

training.model_and_shuffle_seed: torch.manual_seed(seed), numpy.random.seed(seed), and numpy.random.default_rng(seed); the same listed seed initializes the model and epoch group permutation
training.precision_and_determinism: float32 model and differentiable fit physics, float64 exact checkpoint selection and scoring, PyTorch deterministic algorithms and frozen thread counts recorded in the checkpoint manifest
training.optimizer_step_roster: exactly 120 trajectory-by-geometry-by-train-frame groups per epoch: four fit trajectories by three geometries by ten train frames; each group contains all seven fit maps in one batch and produces exactly one optimizer step
training.group_permutation: one numpy.random.default_rng(seed) PCG64 permutation of the same 120 group identities per epoch, continuing one generator state across epochs
training.loss_reduction: reuse the formal DRC differentiable loss reductions over the complete seven-map batch; form one weighted scalar loss, call backward once, clip once, and call optimizer.step once per group

loss_math.relative_mse: for each batch row compute sum(delta^2)/max(sum(target^2),1e-20), then take the arithmetic mean across all seven map rows
loss_math.physical_field: relative_mse(raw normalized physical proposal - normalized physical truth, normalized physical truth)
loss_math.physical_gradient: apply the formal finite_difference_gradient with spacing_xyz=(2/(X-1),2/(Y-1),2/(Z-1)) to raw proposal and truth, then apply relative_mse
loss_math.physical_observation: apply the frozen differentiable exact training forward to the observation-RMS-denormalized raw proposal before any observable line search or K1, then apply relative_mse against the raw observation
loss_math.equivariance: not evaluated and weighted exactly zero for this physical-chart no-map backbone

training.checkpoint_selection: same 84-cell fit-only frame-100 eight-gate lexicographic rule and numeric tolerance as formal v111

controls.online_shell: observable-only nonnegative scalar line search followed by unchanged CGLS K1
forbidden: outer-heldout truth or heldout-map fit rows

controls.parent_label: pose-conditioned CNN without reference-chart map channels

architecture.reference_map_tensor: all thirteen map channels are replaced by exact zeros before both fit and prediction; nonzero map-channel input is rejected

controls.information_boundary: the analytic map still acts once in reference-chart transport and can be implicit in transported base/BP/geometry fields; only the thirteen explicit map channels are removed
controls.training: identical outer folds, seeds, train frames 0 through 90, frame-100-only checkpoint selection, seed mapping, precision, normalization, AdamW settings, four loss weights, 80-epoch ceiling, patience, and fit-only checkpoint-selection rule as formal DRC-Warm
controls.online_shell: identical observable-only line search and unchanged CGLS K1 as DRC-Warm
forbidden: outer-heldout truth or heldout-map fit rows

architecture.base_model: the frozen DRC-Warm convolutional backbone and residual head

controls.information_boundary: camera tokens and FiLM are absent, but the seven local-geometry and thirteen map channels remain visible; this isolates token conditioning rather than all geometry information
controls.training: identical outer folds, seeds, train frames 0 through 90, frame-100-only checkpoint selection, seed mapping, precision, normalization, AdamW settings, four loss weights, 80-epoch ceiling, patience, and fit-only checkpoint-selection rule as formal DRC-Warm
controls.online_shell: identical observable-only line search and unchanged CGLS K1 as DRC-Warm
forbidden: camera token, camera identity, or geometry ID entering FiLM
outer-heldout truth or heldout-map fit rows

control_state_machine.execution_complete: all frozen predictions, actual call receipts, scores, source bindings, mutation checks, and independent recomputation pass for the full roster; required for every control before any comparison
control_state_machine.control_accuracy_pass: the control itself passes the same five-trajectory Stage A gate for the applicable deterministic roster or each of its three seeds; reported separately and not required for a valid ablation mechanism comparison
control_state_machine.drc_component_advantage_pass: DRC satisfies the same-seed paired-better, no-worse-tail, and strict-improvement predicates against the complete ablation predictions; may pass even when the ablation control_accuracy_pass is false
control_state_machine.parent_learned_advantage_pass: DRC passes Stage A, is not dominated by any complete equal-or-lower-call control, satisfies projected-ridge and loaded-q8 paired gates, satisfies every-control tail noninferiority, and all runtime implementations and independent validators are complete

eight_gate_order: four metric ratios versus Zero-CGLS K2 in metric_order
four metric ratios versus Zero-CGLS K4 divided by 1.01 in metric_order
projected_ridge_fit_only_selection_score.selection_partition: select one hyperparameter triple independently within each geometry; each selection sees four fit trajectories by seven fit maps at frame 100 and never aggregates another geometry
projected_ridge_fit_only_selection_score.candidate_primary: maximum of all 28 cells by 8 ordered normalized gate values within the current geometry
projected_ridge_fit_only_selection_score.candidate_secondary: arithmetic mean of all 28 cells by 8 ordered normalized gate values within the current geometry
projected_ridge_fit_only_selection_score.cross_geometry_summary: after all three triples are frozen, report the maximum primary and secondary across geometries for diagnostics only; it cannot change any selected triple
projected_ridge_fit_only_selection_score.breakdown_or_incomplete_roster_action: candidate score is positive infinity and the missing or broken cell list is reported; partial candidate rosters cannot win

all_equal_or_lower_call_controls: normalized geometry-equalized backprojection plus CGLS K1
loaded q8 factor plus CGLS K1
all_required_controls_for_tail_noninferi: normalized geometry-equalized backprojection plus CGLS K1
loaded q8 factor plus CGLS K1
decision_rules.trajectory_equal_p90_higher_and_worst_no: apply to the explicit all_required_controls_for_tail_noninferiority roster, including the higher-call Zero-CGLS K4 accuracy reference

neural_ablation_mechanism_gate.pairing: same seed, trajectory, heldout map, geometry, and frame
neural_ablation_mechanism_gate.strict_improvement_requirement: for every seed, at least one trajectory-by-metric p50, p90-higher, or worst value is lower by more than 1e-12
neural_ablation_mechanism_gate.ablation_dominates_drc: the ablation passes the same five-trajectory Stage A gate, every paired tail is no worse within 1e-12, and at least one tail is lower by more than 1e-12; this closes the corresponding DRC component claim and learned-advantage gate
neural_ablation_mechanism_gate.ablation_fails_stage_a: record control_accuracy_pass=false but keep execution_complete=true when execution is valid; this is not sufficient by itself to claim component necessity, and the paired-better, no-worse-tail, and strict-improvement predicates must still pass before drc_component_advantage_pass=true

failure_actions.control_invalid: retain evidence, repair only the explicit execution defect, and rerun under a new bound release
failure_actions.simple_control_dominance: reject learned advantage and retain the simpler control
failure_actions.neural_ablation_matches_or_beats_drc: reject only the isolated incremental contribution claim: explicit thirteen-channel map encoding for the zero-map ablation, camera-token FiLM for the no-camera ablation, or the larger reference-chart conditioned design relative to the v29-backbone DRC-input ablation; do not reject broader geometry, transport, or map effects that remain implicit in other inputs
failure_actions.parent_gate_failure: do not open wall, RSS, external, or real-BOST gates unless every required control has execution_complete=true and parent_learned_advantage_pass=true; individual control_accuracy_pass values are reported but are not a standalone resource prerequisite
